It was first recorded on September 28, 1939 by English singer Dame Vera Margaret Lewis, better known as Vera Lynn, with Arthur Young."}

{"turn": 3, "kind": "lesson", "lang": "en", "text": "The song is one of the most famous of the World War II era, resonating with servicemen going off to fight as well as their families and loved ones."}

{"turn": 3, "kind": "lesson", "lang": "en", "text": "Now, Background and composition.
